evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.979 Torr at 98.6 sccm Ar before growth.
Pressure rose to 3.110 Torr while Ar remained 99.4 sccm.
Pressure continued rising to 3.202 Torr at 99.7 sccm Ar.

Pressure reached 3.298 Torr despite unchanged flow setpoint and measured Ar of 100.3 sccm; temperature is on target at 750.2 C and oxygen remains low at 4.7 ppm. Progressive pressure rise suggests altered exhaust conductance or pressure control, not a demonstrated specific fault.

args.missing_evidence: Check exhaust conductance and pressure-control operation, and verify pressure independently to distinguish exhaust restriction from other causes of the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
